{"statement": {"value": "-- WoW revenue change using LAG
-- Author: Sarah Chen — weekly trend tile

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATETRUNC(WEEK, CAST(orders.order_date AS DATETIME2)) AS DATE) AS week_start,
    SUM(orders.order_total) AS revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM order_entry_db.order_entry.orders
  WHERE
    orders.order_status NOT IN (3, 4)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATETRUNC(WEEK, CAST(orders.order_date AS DATETIME2)) AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  weekly.week_start,
  weekly.revenue,
  weekly.orders,
  LAG(weekly.revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY weekly.week_start) AS prior_week_revenue,
  weekly.revenue - LAG(weekly.revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY weekly.week_start) AS wow_delta,
  (
    weekly.revenue - LAG(weekly.revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY weekly.week_start)
  ) / NULLIF(LAG(weekly.revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY weekly.week_start), 0) * 100 AS wow_pct
FROM weekly AS weekly
ORDER BY
  week_start
", "language": "SQL"}, "source": "MANUAL", "created": {"time": 1725518711014, "actor": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}, "lastModified": {"time": 1727160311014, "actor": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}, "name": "wow_revenue_change/01-canonical_lag", "description": "How did revenue change week-over-week?", "origin": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}

{"statement": {"value": "-- WoW via self-join — older style but easier to read for some folks
-- Author: Andrea Garcia

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATETRUNC(WEEK, CAST(orders.order_date AS DATETIME2)) AS DATE) AS week_start,
    SUM(orders.order_total) AS revenue
  FROM order_entry_db.order_entry.orders
  WHERE
    orders.order_status NOT IN (3, 4)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATETRUNC(WEEK, CAST(orders.order_date AS DATETIME2)) AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  cur.week_start,
  cur.revenue AS current_revenue,
  prv.revenue AS prior_week_revenue,
  cur.revenue - prv.revenue AS wow_delta,
  (
    cur.revenue - prv.revenue
  ) / NULLIF(prv.revenue, 0) * 100 AS wow_pct
FROM weekly AS cur
LEFT JOIN weekly AS prv
  ON prv.week_start = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, cur.week_start)
ORDER BY
  cur.week_start

{"statement": {"value": "-- WoW revenue via order_details
-- Author: James Wilson

WITH hdr AS (

  FROM hdr AS hdr
  WHERE
    hdr.order_status NOT IN (3, 4)
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATETRUNC(WEEK, CAST(hdr.order_date AS DATETIME2)) AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  weekly.week_start,
  weekly.revenue,
  LAG(weekly.revenue) OVER (ORDER BY weekly.week_start) AS prior_revenue,
  weekly.revenue - LAG(weekly.revenue) OVER (ORDER BY weekly.week_start) AS wow_delta
FROM weekly AS weekly
ORDER BY
  week_start

{"statement": {"value": "-- Online vs in-store AOV comparison
WITH pct AS (
    SELECT order_mode, order_total,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_total) OVER (PARTITION BY order_mode) AS p50
    FROM order_entry_db.order_entry.orders
    WHERE order_mode IN ('ONLINE', 'INSTORE') AND order_status NOT IN (3, 4)
)
SELECT order_mode, COUNT(*) AS orders, AVG(order_total) AS aov, MAX(p50) AS p50
FROM pct
GROUP BY order_mode

{"statement": {"value": "-- Inventory health: how many (product, wh) pairs in each state?

SELECT

  SUM(

      WHEN inventories.quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 1 AND inventories.restock_level - 1
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS low,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN inventories.quantity_on_hand >= inventories.restock_level
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS healthy,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN inventories.quantity_on_hand > inventories.max_stock_level
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS overstocked

{"statement": {"value": "-- Why is product 842 (Smart Wi-Fi Light Bulbs) showing "Out of Stock" status

  p.product_id = 842
ORDER BY
  i.quantity_on_hand DESC

{"statement": {"value": "-- Invariant check: min_price should always be <= list_price.
-- Spotting any inverted entries.
-- Author: Julia (DQE)

SELECT
  products.product_id,
  products.product_name,
  products.list_price,
  products.min_price,
  products.min_price - products.list_price AS gap
FROM order_entry_db.order_entry.products
WHERE
  products.min_price > products.list_price
ORDER BY
  gap DESC

{"statement": {"value": "-- Which products have only ever sold in non-new condition?
-- Trying to identify the marketplace-only catalogue.

SELECT TOP 20
       p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       COUNT(*) AS line_items,
       (SELECT STRING_AGG(d.condition, ', ')
        FROM   (SELECT DISTINCT oi2.condition
                FROM   order_entry_db.order_entry.order_items oi2
                WHERE  oi2.product_id = p.product_id) d) AS conditions_seen
FROM   order_entry_db.order_entry.order_items oi
JOIN   order_entry_db.order_entry.products    p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP  BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN oi.condition = 'New' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER  BY line_items DESC
", "language": "SQL"}, "source": "MANUAL", "created": {"time": 1740044549149, "actor": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}, "lastModified": {"time": 1742114549149, "actor": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}, "name": "noise/refurbished_only_products", "description": "Which products have only ever sold in non-new condition?", "origin": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}

{"statement": {"value": "-- Eastside Logistics Center current load + stock

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS distinct_skus,
  SUM(GREATEST(i.quantity_on_hand, 0)) AS total_units_on_hand
FROM order_entry_db.order_entry.warehouses AS w
LEFT JOIN order_entry_db.order_entry.orders AS o
  ON o.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
  AND CAST(o.order_date AS DATETIME2) >= DATEADD(
    DAY,
    -30,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(CAST(orders.order_date AS DATETIME2)) AS _col_0
      FROM order_entry_db.order_entry.orders
    )
  )
LEFT JOIN order_entry_db.order_entry.inventories AS i
  ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE
  w.warehouse_name = 'Eastside Logistics Center'

{"statement": {"value": "-- Quick — do weekend orders skew differently in mode mix? (Curious from ops chat)

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, CAST(CAST(orders.order_date AS DATETIME2) AS DATE)) IN (0, 6)
    THEN 'weekend'
    ELSE 'weekday'
  END AS period,
  orders.order_mode,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  AVG(orders.order_total) AS aov
FROM order_entry_db.order_entry.orders
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, CAST(CAST(orders.order_date AS DATETIME2) AS DATE)) IN (0, 6)
    THEN 'weekend'
    ELSE 'weekday'
  END,
  orders.order_mode
ORDER BY
  period,
  orders DESC
", "language": "SQL"}, "source": "MANUAL", "created": {"time": 1739834259457, "actor": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}, "lastModified": {"time": 1741130259457, "actor": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}, "name": "noise/weekend_orders_pattern", "description": "Quick — do weekend orders skew differently in mode mix? (Curious from ops chat)", "origin": "urn:li:corpuser:b2fd91.sam@example.com"}
